Added a warning to levels that need Full Speed.

Removed VR toggle when VR mode is enabled.

Work continues, more coming soon!

notes.title: SteamVR beta update 02
notes.content:
Work In Progress! We have found critical issues, and should have the game running properly in SteamVR at the end of February.

Launch from BigPicture mode working.
Launches directly into vr mode if Compositor is running.

No more need for beta, we are running in the main branch.

Note we are currently fighting some issues, have patience!

notes.title: SteamVR beta update 01
notes.content:
Added more debug keys in case headsets have different FOV or Aspect Ratio preferences I don't know about.

PgUp/PgDown : changes FOV
Home/End        : changes Aspect Ratio

The numbers are visible in Settings->Virtual Reality.

If your IPD is strange, the setting that has been sent by the Hmd is shown there also. IPD should always be set directly from Hmd Configuration Tools. 

( beta password 'kumoonsteamvr' )
